_comment: Rerank-ordering / MRR gate (plan §6 #2). Each case is a query plus a fixed candidate shortlist whose truly-relevant member (expected_id) is deliberately placed LAST in the input order, so the pre-rerank baseline (which keeps input order) scores poorly and a working reranker must float the relevant hit toward the top. The gate runs the REAL qwen3:4b reranker, asserts the reranked MRR clears a floor, and reports reranked-vs-baseline MRR so the rerank cost is justified with numbers.
